alt_texts: A spotted jellyfish photographed in Corpus Christi Bay, Texas, against a dark background, headline 'No brain. No heart. No blood.'
A translucent Aequorea jellyfish off Bruny Island, Tasmania, with text about the jellyfish nerve net
A dense swarm of moon jellyfish (Aurelia aurita) in Flensburg Fjord with the statistic that a jellyfish is 95% water
A jellyfish washed up on a pebble beach in Bolinas, California, with text explaining jellyfish have no heart or blood
Spotted jellyfish from Corpus Christi Bay with the statistic of over 500 million years of jellyfish history
Aequorea jellyfish with text about Turritopsis dohrnii reverting to a polyp, noting the pictured jelly is a different species
Closing slide over a beached jellyfish listing scientific sources and photo credits
